bio: The fantastic lakeside location – right by Wörthersee – means the terrace is a popular spot in summer, but sitting inside is also pleasant: the atmosphere is chic and nicely laid-back, and the tables by the windows boast a wonderful view of the lake. Attentive, seasoned staff serve up the delicious seasonal cuisine incorporating many regional ingredients. Be sure to try the handmade cheese and meat noodles. The fish of the day is also highly recommended. And for dessert, perhaps some apricot dumplings? The restaurant is located in the aenea hotel.
